title: Density-aware panel tokens and rollout affordances for cost explorer
creator: Aisha Chen
description: Audit, consolidate, and publish a set of responsive design tokens and component variants for density-aware metric panels used across the Cost Explorer and Rollouts surfaces. Outcome: a Figma variable library and a compact migration guide for engineering that reduce token duplication, ensure accessible contrast at tight densities, and provide explicit affordances for rollout states (canary, stable, failed). This ticket covers prototypes, design reviews, accessibility pass, and handoff artifacts.
acceptance_criteria: A canonical set of density tokens (spacing, typography scale, icon sizes, hit targets) published in Figma Variables
Three component variants for the Panel primitive: spacious, default, compact — with defined token mappings and interaction states
Rollout state affordances (canary / baseline / fallback) with color and microcopy tokens documented and contrast-checked
Design-to-dev handoff packet in Confluence with CSS token names that map to Figma variables and example markup snippets
Engineering review signoff (ENG-20456) confirming tokens are implementable without runtime perf regression
Accessibility audit completed with contrast ratios and touch target checks, and remediation notes for sub-48px tappable areas

decisions: Adopt a 4-step density scale (0..3) to cover compact->spacious needs across console surfaces
Use semantic token keys prefixed with --rdw- to align with runtime naming (examples in Confluence)
Limit minimal tappable height to 44px across density variants; where infeasible, add explicit tooltip affordance
Rollout state colors will use overlay accents (semi-opaque) instead of hard background swaps to avoid reflow in dense lists
tradeoffs_and_notes: Reducing vertical padding increases information density but risks legibility — mitigations: tighter typography with increased line-height and explicit focus styles
More granular tokens ease product-level tweaks but add overhead to engineering props — chosen middle ground: semantic tokens mapped to a small set of numeric scale values
Retrofit for legacy console CSS will require a short migration shim; outlined steps in handoff doc
